instruction: Use Abaqus to perform a torsion analysis of a circular shaft (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Model Definition: Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Revolution. Sketch a rectangle from (0, 0) to (5, 80) in the X-Y plane, using the left vertical edge at X = 0 as the revolution axis (global Y-axis). Revolve 360 deg to generate a solid cylinder with diameter 10 mm and length 80 mm, aligned with the global Y-axis. Material and Section: Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section using Steel and assign it to the entire shaft. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the shaft. Analysis Step: Create a Static, General step named Step-Torque-A. Loads and Boundary Conditions: Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the fixed end face at Y = 0. Create a reference point RP-1 at the center of the free end face (Y = 80 mm) and establish a kinematic coupling between RP-1 and that end face. Apply a torque (Moment) of 850 N*mm at RP-1 about the global Y-axis. Discretization: Mesh the shaft with a global seed size of 4 mm. Assign the element type C3D8R and generate the mesh. Job Execution: Create a job named Job-Torsion-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully. Deliverables: Save the model database as C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Torsion-A.cae and ensure the output database is written to C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Torsion-A.odb. Run the solver to completion and ensure a result file is generated.
